name: scroll-text-marquee-bidirectional
title: Bidirectional Marquee
blurb: Multiple text rows scroll in opposite directions.
description: Marquee effect with parallel rows moving left and right simultaneously, creating visual rhythm.
use_when: Decorative backgrounds or mood-setting section transitions.
avoid_when: Reading-focused content — opposing directions create visual noise.
a11y: Continuous animation with no pause. Text is present but hard to focus on.
